diagrams.name: System Architecture
diagrams.content:
graph TB
    A[Load Balancer] --> B[Web Server 1]
    A --> C[Web Server 2]
    B --> D[Application Server]
    C --> D
    D --> E[Database Primary]
    D --> F[Cache Redis]
    E --> G[Database Replica]

diagrams.name: Request Flow
diagrams.content:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant API
    participant Auth
    participant DB
    
    Client->>API: HTTP Request
    API->>Auth: Validate Token
    Auth-->>API: Token Valid
    API->>DB: Query Data
    DB-->>API: Return Data
    API-->>Client: HTTP Response

diagrams.name: Testing Workflow
diagrams.content:
graph TD
    A[New Feature] --> B[Unit Tests]
    B --> C[Integration Tests]
    C --> D{All Tests Pass?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Deploy to Staging]
    D -->|No| F[Fix Issues]
    F --> B

diagrams.name: Feature State Machine
diagrams.content:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> InReview: Submit
    InReview --> Draft: Request Changes
    InReview --> Testing: Approve
    Testing --> InReview: Failed
    Testing --> Staging: Passed
    Staging --> Production: Deploy
    Production --> [*]

diagrams.name: Database Schema
Class Diagram
diagrams.content:
classDiagram
    class User {
        +String id
        +String name
        +String email
        +login()
        +logout()
    }
    class Order {
        +String id
        +User user
        +calculateTotal()
        +submit()
    }
    User "1" --> "*" Order
